from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One document from the collection with its own title and the titles of papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of other papers referenced in the bibliography of this document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
